claims.residual_paths: eraseSwap and Exchange.eraseData compute paths after removing the first occurrence of a selected operation ID on both endpoints. Formal inverse and composition are respected by construction.
claims.head_pull: pullHead constructs a checked path to wanted :: word.erase wanted under AccessibleHead. It retains every other occurrence in its original order and preserves the full store law for all typed kernels.
claims.local_cells: frontInvolution, frontSelf, frontBraid and frontSwap_tail derive the local comparison cells using existing involution, self contraction, braid and horizontal interchange only.
claims.overlap_coverage: frontPullSquare handles both, one, or neither swapped ID equal to wanted, including extraction from an arbitrarily long common suffix. primitivePullSquare extends the construction under arbitrary common prefixes.
claims.naturality: pullNaturality constructs the square path ; pull(target) ~ pull(source) ; prepend(wanted, eraseData(path)) for every raw checked path, including inverse, composition and reflexivity.
claims.global_coherence: exchangeCoherent constructs HorizontalCoherence signature p q for every two parallel raw Exchange paths p and q. It recurses on source word length by deleting its first label; empty paths contract by structural laws. No additional higher root is introduced in this step.
claims.canonical_factor: canonicalFactor compares path ; canonicalCertificate(target) with the canonical source certificate transported to the common canonical endpoint. This is derived by exchangeCoherent, not postulated as a normalizer-relative root.
claims.execution: Runtime evaluation constructs the actual higher data for braid, separated edits, composite inverses, repeated read-only self-loop, empty word and canonical factorization.

exact_theorem_scope.quantifiers: For arbitrary Slot and Op with decidable equality, signature : Op -> Interface Slot, finite words one two and p q : Exchange signature one two, construct HorizontalCoherence signature p q.
exact_theorem_scope.assumptions: The paths are built from the actual checked read/write exchange syntax. The selected-ID word endpoints identify repeated labels as before. No finite full operation alphabet, total operation order, path enumeration, semantic equality oracle or supplied global coherence premise is required.
exact_theorem_scope.relation: The explicit HorizontalCoherence relation introduced in the preceding step, including earlier groupoid structural laws, self contraction and the separated primitive square. This is not completeness of any older smaller relation.

scope: Global coherence is proved for the checked-exchange fragment in HorizontalCoherence. Copy/discard, general structural circuits, arbitrary cryptographic-box transformations and approximate games are not thereby completed.
No new higher inductive type or generator was added in the five source modules. The global construction uses the already explicit basis and its structural/context closures.

Involution, braid, self and separated exchange roots have bounded active swap boundaries, but structural laws may take arbitrary paths and contexts/operation labels are parameters. No claim of finitely many concrete generators, a uniform bound for every structural-law boundary or full finite derivation type is made.

The runtime tuple counts only the previously defined new separated-square form, excluding all old roots, structural laws, input proofs, contexts, sharing, bytes and checking time. It is not a size or performance advantage.
Private erased random draws and CPU timing are not observations unless encoded in the typed state. No native runtime guarantee or dynamic scheduling/conditioning semantics is added.
Existing actual MAC/caller/cache/trace execution sources remain unchanged. The new runtime examples are diagnostics of the generic proof constructor, not new MAC query reorderings.
Novelty of head-deletion proof construction, formalization priority, conditional-assumption repair and fair comparative proof cost remain unconfirmed.
